title: Make 10 Mastery Check
objective: Determine whether the Make 10 bridge (addition and subtraction), error diagnosis, and strategy selection are secure before Unit 2.1 begins. Completes the release's number-sense strand.

tasks.prompt: Independently solve a new Make-10 addition problem (not previously drilled), narrating each stage (SEE/BREAK/BUILD/TRANSFORM) aloud.
Diagnose a shown broken Make-10 attempt and correct it.
Correctly decide whether a given problem needs a bridge at all, before solving it.

mastery.passEvidence: All four tasks correct, with the narration in task 1 including the words "same value" or an equivalent phrase when stating the transform step.
mastery.reteachTrigger: Gets a correct final answer in task 1 but cannot narrate the stages (reteach with more think-aloud modeling, not more problems) or fails to catch the wrong-target-split error in task 3 (reteach 1.3.6).
